Ứng dụng Tệp (Files) và Zalo trên iPhone chặn JavaScript, nên nút 🔊, chấm điểm và micro đều bị vô hiệu.
👉 Hãy mở bài học bằng đường link https:// mà giáo viên gửi (bấm vào link trong Zalo ➔ chọn biểu tượng la bàn Safari).
Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. ecosystem (n)
/ˈiːkəʊsɪstəm/
hệ sinh thái tự nhiên
Collocation: fragile ecosystem, marine ecosystem
"Coral reefs form a fragile marine ecosystem that supports thousands of fish."
2. biodiversity (n)
/ˌbaɪəʊdaɪˈvɜːsəti/
đa dạng sinh học
Collocation: preserve biodiversity, rich biodiversity
"National parks play a vital role in protecting rich local biodiversity."
3. conservation (n)
/ˌkɒnsəˈveɪʃn/
sự bảo tồn thiên nhiên
Collocation: nature conservation, wildlife conservation project
"The government invested millions of dollars in forest conservation programs."
4. habitat (n)
/ˈhæbɪtæt/
môi trường sống tự nhiên (của động thực vật)
Collocation: natural habitat, loss of habitat
"Pandas are losing their natural habitat due to rapid land development."
5. renewable (adj)
/rɪˈnjuːəbl/
có thể tái tạo (năng lượng sạch)
Collocation: renewable energy, renewable resources
"Wind and solar power are clean, renewable energy sources."
6. pollution (n)
/pəˈluːʃn/
sự ô nhiễm
Collocation: air pollution, reduce plastic pollution
"Public transport helps reduce air pollution in crowded cities."
7. emission (n)
/ɪˈmɪʃn/
khí thải, sự phát thải
Collocation: carbon emissions, cut greenhouse gas emissions
"Electric vehicles produce zero tailpipe carbon emissions."
8. climate (n)
/ˈklaɪmət/
khí hậu, biến đổi khí hậu
Collocation: climate change, tropical climate
"Global climate change is causing more extreme weather events."
9. preserve (v)
/prɪˈzɜːv/
gìn giữ, bảo vệ nguyên vẹn
Collocation: preserve nature, preserve ancient forests
"Citizens must work together to preserve clean rivers for future generations."
10. landscape (n)
/ˈlændskeɪp/
cảnh quan, phong cảnh địa형
Collocation: natural landscape, mountain landscape
"The northern region is famous for its breathtaking mountain landscape."
11. urban (adj)
/ˈɜːbən/
thuộc về đô thị, thành phố
Collocation: urban areas, urban green spaces
"Planting trees in urban areas lowers street temperatures during summer."
12. species (n)
/ˈspiːʃiːz/
loài (động vật hoặc thực vật)
Collocation: endangered species, rare plant species
"Strict laws protect endangered species from illegal hunting."
13. recycle (v)
/ˌriːˈsaɪkl/
tái chế rác thải
Collocation: recycle paper and glass, easily recycled
"Every household should sort and recycle plastic containers weekly."
14. contaminate (v)
/kənˈtæmɪneɪt/
làm ô nhiễm, làm nhiễm độc (nước/đất)
Collocation: contaminate drinking water, contaminated soil
"Industrial waste can seriously contaminate nearby rivers and lakes."
15. deforestation (n)
/ˌdiːˌfɒrɪˈsteɪʃn/
nạn phá rừng
Collocation: widespread deforestation, halt deforestation
"Widespread deforestation destroys thousands of acres of tropical rainforest."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Căn Bản (So Sánh Hơn, So Sánh Nhất & Giới Từ Vị Trí)

• So sánh hơn (Comparative): Dùng để đối chiếu 2 đối tượng.
  - Tính từ ngắn: Adj-er + than (cleaner than, greener than, hotter than).
  - Tính từ dài: more + Adj + than (more sustainable than, more polluted than).
  Ví dụ: Solar power is cleaner than coal energy.

• So sánh nhất (Superlative): So sánh 1 đối tượng nổi bật nhất trong nhóm (từ 3 trở lên).
  - Tính từ ngắn: the + Adj-est (the largest, the cleanest).
  - Tính từ dài: the most + Adj (the most diverse ecosystem).

• Giới từ chỉ vị trí cho bài Map Labelling: opposite (đối diện), adjacent to / next to (kề bên), across from (bên kia đường), in the northern corner (ở góc phía bắc).

🔵 Tầng 2: Nâng Cao (Nhấn Mạnh So Sánh & Cấu Trúc Càng... Càng...)

• Trạng từ nhấn mạnh mức độ so sánh (Modifiers): Để nâng điểm GRA trong Writing Task 1 & Speaking, thêm much / far / significantly / considerably trước tính từ so sánh hơn.
  Ví dụ: Air pollution in industrial zones is significantly worse than in rural villages.

• So sánh kép (Double Comparatives - Càng... càng...):
  Công thức: The + comparative + S + V, the + comparative + S + V
  Ví dụ: The more trees we plant in urban areas, the cleaner our city air becomes.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. Coral reefs form a delicate marine ________ that provides food and shelter for sea life.
2. Cutting down tropical forests causes many rare animals to lose their natural ________.
3. Wind, solar, and hydro power are examples of clean, ________ energy sources.
4. Chemical waste from factories can seriously ________ the local drinking water supply.
5. Switching from private cars to electric trains helps cut greenhouse gas ________.
6. The Amazon rainforest is famous for its rich ________, with millions of plant and insect types.
7. Local authorities launched a wildlife ________ program to protect sea turtles.
8. Rapid ________ for agriculture has destroyed vast areas of ancient woodland.
9. Creating more green parks in ________ areas helps city residents relax after work.
10. The giant panda and the snow leopard are well-known endangered ________.
11. Citizens are encouraged to sort and ________ glass bottles, paper, and aluminum cans.
12. Ha Long Bay attracts millions of tourists thanks to its stunning limestone ________.
13. Rising global temperatures are a clear warning sign of severe ________ change.
14. National heritage laws aim to ________ ancient forests for future generations.
15. Heavy traffic congestion is the primary cause of severe air ________ in megacities.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 1] Volunteering at the nature reserve gave students a valuable ________ to learn about botany.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 1] Using cloth bags instead of plastic is a simple ________ habit.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 2] Environmental science is now a compulsory subject in our school ________.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 2] Undergraduates must ________ with each other on the ecology field project.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 2] We must submit our environmental research ________ before Friday's deadline.

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. Solar energy is much ________ for the environment than burning coal or oil.
2. The Amazon rainforest is ________ tropical ecosystem in the world.
3. Plastic waste is one of ________ threats to marine biodiversity today.
4. Air quality in rural mountain villages is significantly ________ than in industrial urban centers.
5. According to the park map, the Botanical Garden is located right ________ to the Visitor Center.
6. Walk ________ the wooden bridge, and you will see the bird conservation area on your left.
7. The more renewable energy we use, ________ carbon emissions we release into the atmosphere.
8. Protecting natural habitats is far ________ than trying to rebuild a destroyed ecosystem.
9. The recycling station is situated ________ the main entrance and the bicycle parking lot.
10. Last summer recorded ________ temperatures in our country's history due to climate change.
Điểm: 0/10

Tốc độ đọc:
Trạng thái: Sẵn sàng phát Câu: 0 / 15
💡 Bấm vào bất kỳ câu thoại nào để nghe riêng câu đó:
👨 Ranger: Good morning! Welcome to Green Valley Nature Reserve. Are you joining our morning conservation tour?
👩 Visitor: Hello! Yes, I would love to join. Could you tell me a bit about the reserve's layout first?
👨 Ranger: Certainly! Right here at the main gate is our Reception Building. Directly opposite the reception is the Solar Cafe. 💡 Đáp án câu 1: Solar Cafe / Cafe
👩 Visitor: Oh, does the cafe run on renewable energy?
👨 Ranger: Yes, 100% solar power! Now, if you follow the forest path north across the wooden bridge, you will reach the Wetland Habitat. 💡 Đáp án câu 2: Wetland Habitat / Wetland
👩 Visitor: What endangered species can we observe in the Wetland Habitat?
👨 Ranger: It is home to over forty rare species of water birds, including the black-necked crane. 💡 Đáp án câu 3: water birds / birds
👩 Visitor: That sounds amazing! Where do the hands-on conservation activities take place?
👨 Ranger: Our tree-planting zone is located in the eastern corner, adjacent to the Organic Nursery. 💡 Đáp án câu 4: Organic Nursery / Nursery
👩 Visitor: Can visitors also learn how to recycle organic waste during the tour?
👨 Ranger: Absolutely. At 11:00 AM, we hold a zero-waste workshop at the Education Pavilion. 💡 Đáp án câu 5: 11:00 AM / 11 AM
👩 Visitor: How much does the full-day eco-pass cost for university students?
👨 Ranger: With a student card, the ticket is only 12 pounds, and all funds go directly to forest preservation. 💡 Đáp án câu 6: 12 pounds / 12
👩 Visitor: Here is my student ID. I'm really excited to explore the landscape!
👨 Ranger: Thank you! Here is your map and reusable water bottle. Enjoy your visit!
Điểm: 0/6

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - The Threat of Urban Expansion]
Over the past fifty years, rapid industrial growth and widespread deforestation have transformed the natural landscape. In many crowded urban centers, heavy traffic releases massive carbon emissions, causing severe air pollution and accelerating global climate change. Furthermore, untreated factory waste can contaminate local rivers, destroying the fragile aquatic ecosystem.

[Paragraph B - Green Roofs & Eco-Corridors]
Fortunately, city planners and scientists are now working together to preserve nature within modern cities. Many European capitals have created 'green corridors'—connected parks and tree-lined canals that provide a safe habitat for birds and insects. By planting native trees, cities can protect local biodiversity and offer shelter to endangered species.

[Paragraph C - Renewable Energy & Citizen Conservation]
Successful nature conservation also requires active participation from citizens. Switching to renewable solar energy and learning to recycle household plastic are much more effective when whole communities work together. When cities invest in green spaces, they become healthier, cleaner, and more sustainable places to live.
Điểm: 0/6
